title: Navigation
description: Per-drone configuration for the ADOS Navigation plugin.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: Operating mode. optical_flow uses a downward camera plus a rangefinder; optical_flow_degraded takes its scale from the barometer (or GPS height in outdoor mode) instead; external_nav sends the pose from a shared pose topic (for example a lidar SLAM) as ODOMETRY and switches the EKF source set; off keeps the plugin loaded but silent.

active.title: Engaged
active.description: Written by the Engage Skill. Off idles navigation: nothing is sent to the flight controller.

flow_quality_min.title: Flow quality gate
flow_quality_min.description: Minimum optical-flow quality (0-255) for the estimator to report converged and for the pre-arm flow check to pass.

outdoor.title: Outdoor mode
outdoor.description: Outdoor mode: allow the GPS altitude rung, measured from the first 3D fix.

external_nav.title: External navigation
external_nav.description: Used in external_nav mode. The pose topic must be published by an installed plugin; the agent refuses the mode without it.

pose_topic.title: Pose topic
pose_topic.description: Shared topic carrying the pose descriptor (map frame converted to FRD).

origin_lla.title: EKF origin
origin_lla.description: [latitude deg, longitude deg, altitude m AMSL] of the take-off site. Sent as SET_GPS_GLOBAL_ORIGIN when the flight controller has none, is disarmed, GPS is not primary, and the external-nav source set's EK3_SRCn_POSXY reads 6 (ExternalNav), 5 s after the flight controller boots. Prefer the flight controller setting it at boot (AHRS_OPTIONS bit 4 with AHRS_ORIGIN_LAT/LON/ALT set to the same place). Required in external_nav mode unless GPS is primary.

extnav_set.title: External-nav source set
extnav_set.description: EKF source set (EK3_SRCn) whose position source is ExternalNav.

fallback_set.title: Fallback source set
fallback_set.description: EKF source set used when the external pose is lost (the flight controller's optical-flow set), or the GPS set when GPS is primary.

gps_primary.title: GPS primary
gps_primary.description: Fly on GPS and switch to the external pose only while the GPS has no 3D fix or reports a horizontal accuracy worse than 5 m.

obstacle.title: Obstacle feed
obstacle.description: Turns a shared planar scan into OBSTACLE_DISTANCE for the flight controller's proximity avoidance (PRX1_TYPE 2). On by default: it sends whenever a LiDAR scan arrives, with navigation engaged or not, so the flight controller's proximity backstop has data on a GNSS flight too. Off on a node with no flight controller.

sectors.title: Sectors
sectors.description: Number of equal sectors over 360 degrees (72 = 5 degrees each).

rangefinder.title: Rangefinder
rangefinder.description: Distance source used to scale optical flow into metric velocity.

topology.title: Topology
topology.description: Where the rangefinder is wired. companion = plugin reads it; fc = flight controller already publishes DISTANCE_SENSOR; none = no rangefinder.

driver.title: Driver
driver.description: fc_relay reads the flight controller's DISTANCE_SENSOR stream; tfluna_uart reads a Benewake TF-Luna on a companion serial port.

device.title: Device node
device.description: Serial device path (for example /dev/ttyUSB0) for the TF-Luna. Optional when topology is fc or none.

baud.title: Baud rate
baud.description: Only used for the TF-Luna UART driver.

navigation.map_placement.title: Map placement
navigation.map_placement.description: Where the heavy map is built. The navigation map and the live occupancy always stay on board. onboard: full 5 cm sweep cloud on the drone. stream: raw scans stream to a reconstruction node, which builds the map live; the drone keeps a 20 cm cloud. post_flight: record only, upload after landing. hybrid: a 10 cm cloud on board plus the session uploaded after landing.

navigation.memory_budget_mb.title: Map memory budget (MB)
navigation.memory_budget_mb.description: RAM the live map may hold: sweep cloud 60 %, occupancy 40 %. Unset: 80 % of this extension's memory cap.

navigation.pose_publish_interval_ms.title: Pose publish interval (ms)
navigation.pose_publish_interval_ms.description: Interval between published navigation poses in their own measurement time (33 for 30 Hz), kept on average; a pose up to half an interval early is published. The pose cannot publish faster than its provider estimates.

navigation.takeoff_heading_deg.title: Take-off heading (deg)
navigation.takeoff_heading_deg.description: The heading the drone faces where it starts, degrees clockwise from true north. Set it when the flight controller takes its heading from the map indoors: the map's north is then fixed from it once and never from the flight controller. Leave empty to follow the flight controller's compass heading until take-off.

navigation.pose_provider.title: Pose provider
navigation.pose_provider.description: auto: LiDAR odometry when the rig declares the LiDAR and its IMU, else Basalt VIO on a Visor stereo rig, else none. The flight controller's own EKF is not a Navigation pose: it is the flight controller's fallback source set.

scale.description: Resolution VIO tracks at: 1 (as captured) or 0.5 (half in each direction, a quarter of the optical-flow work).

lidar_id.description: Rig sensor id of the LiDAR; its `lidar.model` picks the driver.

imu.description: Rig IMU a planar LiDAR's scans are levelled with. `fc` synthesises it from the flight controller's attitude for a companion without an IMU (declare a rig IMU sensor `fc` at the body origin).

runtime.description: Prebuilt KISS-ICP runtime the 3D LiDAR odometry runs on, relative to the install directory (default `lib/<arch>-linux/kiss-icp-runtime`, which the release installs per arch). A tree writable by group or others, or owned by another user, is refused.

uv.description: Developer fallback when no runtime is installed: the uv that syncs the odometry project into the data dir (needs the package index). A bare name is looked up on PATH; a path is relative to the install directory.

device.description: Serial port path, `tcp:<host>:<port>`, or `auto` (USB discovery); empty turns the driver off.

host_ip.description: Host address on the LiDAR's subnet; null turns the driver off.

source.description: `realsense` (Intel RealSense D435i / D455), `we` (the World Engine depth stream), `vision` (the vision engine's camera depth on the plugin bus; needs the `vision.depth.read` permission) or `off`.

extrinsic.description: The camera's mount on the body: `translation_m` in body forward-right-down from the body origin, and the rotation as `rpy_deg` (roll, pitch, yaw, Z-Y-X; all zero looks forward, pitch -90 straight down) or `quat_wxyz`, not both. Neither: straight ahead, except for `vision`, which then takes the camera pitch the vision engine reports.

we_host.description: Address of the World Engine host serving the depth stream.

we_port.description: The vehicle's depth port: 7810 plus its SITL lease.

vision_camera.description: `vision` (required): the camera whose depth the service leases from the vision engine (renewed every 5 s, released on stop) and maps.

vision_max_fit_age_ms.description: `vision`: a frame whose metric scale fit is older than this is counted and left out of the map, milliseconds.

serial.description: Only the camera with this serial number; empty takes the first found.

navigation.voxmap.description: The 3D voxel map the ADOS pilot plans and brakes on, published to it through shared memory at 10 Hz.

enabled.description: null: on when the LiDAR is a 3D LiDAR, when a depth camera is configured, or when the LiDAR is planar and `planar` is true. true or false forces it.

planar.description: Feed planar LiDAR scans into the map, placed at their true height from the attitude; only returns within the flight band count.

window.description: `default`: 0.2 m voxels over 24 x 24 x 10 m. `fine`: 0.15 m voxels over 30 x 30 x 12 m, for an RK3588-class board with 8 GB.

esdf_every.description: Update the obstacle-distance field every this many map frames (2 halves its cost on a slower board).

depth_max_range_m.description: Depth camera returns farther than this are left out of the map, metres.

type.title: Firmware
type.description: Flight controller firmware. ArduPilot and iNav (7.0+) receive OPTICAL_FLOW; PX4 receives OPTICAL_FLOW_RAD. Betaflight is not supported because the firmware has no position estimator.

camera_id.title: Flow camera id
camera_id.description: Agent camera id the flow is computed from, for example the downward camera. Empty takes frames from every camera.

device_path.title: Device path
device_path.description: Reported to the GCS as the camera when no flow camera id is set. Frames come from the agent's vision bus; choose the captured camera in the agent's camera settings.

orientation.title: Mount orientation
orientation.description: Both optical-flow modes need downward (or auto); forward or side leaves navigation disengaged.
